# 04 — Reconcile contradictory evidence without inventing certainty

## Outcome
Make disagreement a first-class product feature.

## Requirements
- Add claim-to-claim relationships: `supports`, `updates`, `contradicts`, `supersedes`, `contextualises`.
- Compare metric definition, geography, surface/mode, sampling frame and time window before declaring a contradiction.
- Preserve both original claims; never overwrite history.
- Compute an agency interpretation and confidence adjustment separately from the source claims.
- UI expansion must show why two findings differ.

## Canonical acceptance case: Reddit / ChatGPT
Ingest the August 2026 Semrush/Promptwatch report saying Reddit's ChatGPT citation share fell from ~3.8% to ~0.5%, and the September 2026 Ahrefs study showing Reddit at 16.8% mention share in its US ChatGPT dataset. Do **not** resolve this as either “Reddit is dead” or “nothing happened”. Explain the incompatible metric/time-window/dataset context and classify the current agency view appropriately.

## Real product proof required
The observation plane must show a contested Reddit/ChatGPT topic with both studies, relationship(s), methodology differences, agency interpretation and reduced/qualified confidence. Include a screenshot/export in the issue.
